about: The one source of the native look's tokens (#273, #275): metrics.ts and controlsCopy.ts read it for the plugins, android-tokens.cjs writes it as Java for the Android apps. Each value says where it comes from; packages/ui-kit/native-catalog.md records how each was measured (#272); a [DEFAULT, ...] is not measured yet.

pxPerMm.source: physical pixels per millimetre on the 299 ppi Manta screen

touchTarget.source: the smallest touch target (Ink2Pic brief section 8.4)

controlHeight.source: a button and the text field: one height, so a field and its button line up

rowButtonWidth.source: a button in a list row: one width, so the buttons of every row share a column (#68)

space.source: the one spacing step every spacing role starts from [DEFAULT, calibrate on device]

border.source: the thick ink border of a button, a tile and the field (brief section 8.4)

separator.source: the solid line after a group's last row, and under a menu's or a screen's caption row: 2 px ink [measured on the tablet's Settings screens and the native Page menu, 1920 x 2560 px, #272: packages/ui-kit/native-catalog.md › Lines]

lightLine.source: the light dotted line between two rows of one group: 1 px ink [measured on the native Page menu and Settings › Apps › Plugins, 1920 x 2560 px, #272: packages/ui-kit/native-catalog.md › Lines]

lightDash.source: a dash of the light line: 3 px [measured on the native Page menu and Settings › Apps › Plugins, 1920 x 2560 px, #272: packages/ui-kit/native-catalog.md › Lines]

lightGap.source: the gap between two dashes of the light line: 4 px [measured on the native Page menu and Settings › Apps › Plugins, 1920 x 2560 px, #272: packages/ui-kit/native-catalog.md › Lines]

selectionStroke.source: the selection border around a chosen item: 5 px ink [measured on the note sidebar's open Page button, #272: packages/ui-kit/native-catalog.md › Selection border]

selectionRadius.source: the selection border's outer corner radius: about 11 px [measured on the note sidebar's open Page button, #272: packages/ui-kit/native-catalog.md › Selection border]

selectionInset.source: from the selection border's inner edge to the chosen item: 12 px [measured on Manage Pages' current page, #272: packages/ui-kit/native-catalog.md › Selection border]

rowIcon.source: a row's leading icon box, as a plugin's icon in Settings › Apps › Plugins: 56 px, the icon drawn about 48 px inside [#272: packages/ui-kit/native-catalog.md › Icons in rows]

iconGap.source: from a row's leading icon box to its title: 23 px [#272: packages/ui-kit/native-catalog.md › Icons in rows]

bodyFont.source: the native row title and section caption, regular weight: sp_px_34, 21.11 sp = 39.6 px [measured from com.ratta.settings's resources, Manta values (sw1024dp, 1.875 px per dp), #275]

titleFont.source: the native title bar's title, regular weight: sp_px_40, 24.84 sp = 46.6 px [measured from com.ratta.settings's resources, Manta values (sw1024dp, 1.875 px per dp), #275]

subtitleFont.source: a row's subtitle: the native sp_px_30, 18.63 sp = 34.9 px = 2.96 mm, raised to minFont, which is the same 19 layout units on the Manta [measured from com.ratta.settings's resources, Manta values (sw1024dp, 1.875 px per dp), #275]

minFont.source: the Supernote's own system text, the note title in the bottom bar, about 2.2 mm cap height in a device screenshot (brief section 8.4, #85); text a person must read is never smaller, and `npm run renders` fails a screen that is

titleBarHeight.source: the black band of the title bar: dp_px_114, 70.8 dp = 132.8 px [measured from com.ratta.settings's resources, Manta values (sw1024dp, 1.875 px per dp), #275]

navMarkWidth.source: the bar that marks the open item of the navigation list, at its trailing edge: 9 px [measured on the tablet's Settings screens, 1920 x 2560 px, #272: packages/ui-kit/native-catalog.md › Navigation list]

switchWidth.source: the switch's track, a pill: 136 px wide [measured on the tablet's Settings screens, 1920 x 2560 px, #272: packages/ui-kit/native-catalog.md › Switch]

radioSize.source: the radio button's ring: 54 px [measured on the tablet's Settings screens, 1920 x 2560 px, #272: packages/ui-kit/native-catalog.md › Radio button]

radioDot.source: the radio button's filled dot: 30 px [measured on the tablet's Settings screens, 1920 x 2560 px, #272: packages/ui-kit/native-catalog.md › Radio button]

iconSize.source: the drawn icons of the icon buttons: the trash and the cloud download, 52 px [measured on the tablet's Settings screens, 1920 x 2560 px, #272: packages/ui-kit/native-catalog.md › Icons]

rowHeight.source: a list row's fixed height, one or two lines of text: 162 px, dp_px_139 [measured on the tablet's Settings screens, 1920 x 2560 px, #272: packages/ui-kit/native-catalog.md › List row]

sideMargin.source: from a pane's edge to a row's text and from a row's last control to the other edge: 51 px, dp_px_44 [measured on the tablet's Settings screens, 1920 x 2560 px, #272: packages/ui-kit/native-catalog.md › List row]

captionHeight.source: a section caption's box, from the line above to the caption's bottom, its text at the bottom: 112 px, the native Plugins list's (Keyboard's dp_px_85 box is 99 px; Ink Tools takes the Plugins list's, as its caption) [measured on the tablet, #272: packages/ui-kit/native-catalog.md › Section caption]

markStroke.source: the stroke of the drawn marks: the ×, the ‹, the ›, the radio's ring and the remove ring: 5 px [measured on the tablet's Settings screens, 1920 x 2560 px, #272: packages/ui-kit/native-catalog.md › Title bar]

closeMark.source: the × of the title bar, a square: 48 px [measured on the tablet's Settings screens, 1920 x 2560 px, #272: packages/ui-kit/native-catalog.md › Title bar]

closeCentre.source: from the leading edge to the ×'s centre: 70 px [measured on the tablet's Settings screens, 1920 x 2560 px, #272: packages/ui-kit/native-catalog.md › Title bar]

backMarkHeight.source: the ‹ of the title bar: 56 px tall and 31 px wide, two strokes at a right angle [measured on the tablet's Settings screens, 1920 x 2560 px, #272: packages/ui-kit/native-catalog.md › Title bar]

chevronHeight.source: the › at a row's trailing edge: 42 px tall and 23 px wide, two strokes at a right angle [measured on the tablet's Settings screens, 1920 x 2560 px, #272: packages/ui-kit/native-catalog.md › Chevron]

markGap.source: between a row's value and its ›, and between the switch's word and its track: 26 px [measured on the tablet's Settings screens, 1920 x 2560 px, #272: packages/ui-kit/native-catalog.md › Chevron]

switchHeight.source: the switch's track: 70 px tall [measured on the tablet's Settings screens, 1920 x 2560 px, #272: packages/ui-kit/native-catalog.md › Switch]

switchKnob.source: the switch's round knob: 41 px [measured on the tablet's Settings screens, 1920 x 2560 px, #272: packages/ui-kit/native-catalog.md › Switch]

paneTitleStart.source: from the leading edge to the left pane's title in the black bar: 142 px [measured on Language & Region, #272: packages/ui-kit/native-catalog.md › Title bar]

navPaneWidth.source: the left pane of a two-level screen, its list and its title: 552 px [measured on the tablet's Settings screens, 1920 x 2560 px, #272: packages/ui-kit/native-catalog.md › Navigation list]

smallButtonWidth.source: the small filled button in a row, such as «Scan»: 193 px wide at least [measured on the tablet's Settings screens, 1920 x 2560 px, #272: packages/ui-kit/native-catalog.md › Small filled button]

smallButtonHeight.source: the small filled button: 79 px tall [measured on the tablet's Settings screens, 1920 x 2560 px, #272: packages/ui-kit/native-catalog.md › Small filled button]

largeFont.source: the large type: the ×, ‹ and › glyphs, as a multiple of the body font size

lineHeight.source: the line height of the status line, as a multiple of its font size

selectedBarBorders.source: a selected toggle's bar is this many borders thick

pageMarkBorders.source: the underline of the pager's current page, in borders [DEFAULT, measure in #272]

ink.source: text, borders, the primary button's fill

context.source: section headings, hints and values: 9.7:1 on paper (README › Grey as colour, #50)

placeholder.source: the field's placeholder: a grey that keeps 7:1 contrast on paper (interface rule 3)

selection.source: selected text in the field: a light grey, so the ink text stays readable over it

on.source: the switch when on, as the native Settings write it

off.source: the switch when off, as the native Settings write it

back.source: the spoken name of the title bar's ‹

barTitle.source: the title in the black bar: the screen's, the left pane's and the page's, sp_px_40, regular [measured from com.ratta.settings's layouts and screens, #272: packages/ui-kit/native-catalog.md › Text styles]

caption.source: a section caption over its rows: the native Plugins list's section title (tv_hub_section_title, «Enabled (8/10)»), sp_px_30, smaller than the rows, in the context grey so the levels read apart at a glance (owner, #275); other native captions such as «Installed Languages» are sp_px_34 and black [measured from com.ratta.settings's layouts and screens, #272: packages/ui-kit/native-catalog.md › Text styles]

rowTitle.source: a row's title and a navigation item's label, sp_px_34, regular, black [measured from com.ratta.settings's layouts and screens, #272: packages/ui-kit/native-catalog.md › Text styles]

subtitle.source: a row's subtitle and value, a group's note, a description and the switch's word, sp_px_30, regular, black; the native «By:», version and size lines (sp_px_26) are below minFont and take this style too [measured from com.ratta.settings's layouts and screens, #272: packages/ui-kit/native-catalog.md › Text styles]

hint.source: a hint or a status line of Ink Tools' own, in the context grey, the subtitle's size as the native grey value; the native Settings screens show no grey text but a value that cannot change (README › Grey as colour, #50)
